title: Cross-platform transcriptional profiling identifies common and distinct molecular pathologies in Lewy body diseases
main_conclusions_short: Shared and distinct cell-type transcriptional changes across PD/PDD/DLB; increased microglia/vascular proportions in LBD; widespread RNA-splicing dysregulation esp. PDD/DLB; genetic risk enrichment in specific cell types
notes: Verified from PMC DAS. Team Hardy/Ryten. n per group verified (7 each).

title: Single-cell transcriptomic and proteomic analysis of Parkinson's disease brains
main_conclusions_short: Elevated brain-resident T cells in PD; alpha-syn pathology inversely correlated with chaperone expression in excitatory neurons; reduced neuron-astrocyte interactions and increased neuroinflammation; proteomics concordant
notes: Verified. Preprint described 12 individuals; published 6 PD + 6 ctrl. Team Hafler.

title: Transcriptomic changes in oligodendrocytes and precursor cells associate with clinical outcomes of Parkinson's disease
main_conclusions_short: ODCs/OPCs enriched for PD GWAS risk; dysregulated tau-kinase/inclusion-body pathways; PRS from DEGs predicts MoCA and BDI-II but not UPDRS-III
notes: Verified DAS. Donor counts not extracted (small cohort) - check paper Table 1.

title: Dissecting the molecular landscape of Parkinson's disease and Parkinson's disease dementia using highly efficient snRNA-seq (HIF-snRNA-seq)
main_conclusions_short: Lower astrocyte proportions in PD and PDD (microglia possibly up); distinct PD vs PDD DEGs; Braak stage drives expression more than diagnosis (early up, late down); tau-linked early and inflammation-linked late genes
notes: Verified from bioRxiv full text (groups, nuclei). 77 samples from 240 screened. Preprint only.

title: Molecular and cellular signatures differentiate Parkinson's disease from Parkinson's disease with dementia
regions: anterior cingulate gyrus; inferior parietal lobule
main_conclusions_short: PD and PDD molecularly distinct with little DEG overlap; PD widespread upregulation and robust regional signatures; PDD pathway downregulation and loss of cortical regional identity; PDD transcript-usage shifts incl. APP isoforms
notes: Verified counts from bioRxiv. Accession link inferred (Zenodo 19932738: 128 samples ACG+IPL late-stage PD, Team Hardy; = 64 donors x 2). Code github mgrantpeters/ASAP_teamhardy_snrnaseq.

title: Single-nucleus RNA sequencing of human post-mortem brain tissue from Parkinson's disease and control donors (ASAP dataset)
regions: eight brain regions (not specified in record)
main_conclusions_short: NA - no associated publication found
notes: Dataset-only (Team Hardy; Toomey/Fairbrother-Browne/Ryten). Related Braak 3/4 cohort used by Breiter 2025 bioRxiv (imaging, not seq). Uncertain: no paper.

title: A multi-region single nucleus transcriptomic atlas of Parkinson's disease
regions: DMNX; globus pallidus interna; primary motor cortex; DLPFC; primary visual cortex
accession: AMP PD Knowledge Platform Release 4; CELLxGENE d5d0df8f-4eee-49d8-a221-a288f50a1590
data_access: controlled (AMP-PD registration); processed open on CELLxGENE
main_conclusions_short: Data descriptor: 100 donors spanning Braak PD stages, five regions; QC and annotation resource
notes: Verified. Mount Sinai (Roussos). Same cohort as clarence2025 (analysis paper). Likely the 'multiregion CELLxGENE atlas' seed.

title: A Transcriptomic Roadmap of Parkinson's Disease Progression at Single Cell Resolution
regions: DMNX; GPi; primary motor cortex; prefrontal cortex; primary visual cortex
main_conclusions_short: 62 cell subtypes; convergent upregulation of stress programs (UPR, DNA damage repair, autophagy) across cell types; regulators HSF1/MYC/FOXO3; DE signatures linked to PD GWAS/TWAS; transcriptomic pathology score and pseudotime of progression
notes: Verified. Analysis paper for prashant2024 data (overlapping donors; do not double count).

title: Massive-scale single-nucleus multi-omics identifies novel rare noncoding drivers of Parkinson's disease
main_conclusions_short: Cell-type-specific PD features across 5 regions; cell-type caQTL/eQTL maps; ML models of variant regulatory effect; rare noncoding variants associated with sporadic and familial PD
notes: Abstract verified. Regions and data access not verified. Possible match for 'Menon 2026 multiregion' seed; GP2-affiliated. Co-authors incl. Kozlenkov/Dracheva (Mount Sinai).

title: Single-cell atlas of transcriptomic vulnerability across brain disorders
n_other_disease: AD 519; DLBD 112; vascular dementia 85; SCZ 177; BD 72; tauopathy; FTD; others
accession: AD Knowledge Portal / Synapse syn60084804 (PsychAD); CELLxGENE 84ce6837-548d-4a1f-919f-0bc0d9a3952f; Zenodo 14606776 (Xenium)
main_conclusions_short: Large inter-individual variation; universal cross-disease signatures (mRNA processing, protein localization); AD/DLBD/Vas/PD form concordant neurodegenerative cluster; disease-specific cell-type vulnerabilities
notes: Verified (PD n=48, DLBD n=112 from fullard2025). PsychAD consortium (Roussos).

title: Population-scale cross-disorder atlas of the human prefrontal cortex at single-cell resolution
n_other_disease: AD 519; DLBD 112; Vas 85; SCZ 177; BD 72; others
main_conclusions_short: Data descriptor of PsychAD DLPFC atlas; 21% donors comorbid; detailed neuropsychiatric symptom phenotypes
notes: Verified. Same data as lee2026 (do not double count).

title: Single-nucleus multi-omics of Parkinson's disease reveals a glutamatergic neuronal subtype susceptible to gene dysregulation via alteration of transcriptional networks
accession: Synapse syn60245188, syn50996869; Duke Research Data Repository
data_access: controlled (Synapse on request); counts in Duke repository
main_conclusions_short: A glutamatergic excitatory neuron subtype shows strongest PD DE incl. GWAS-locus genes; only subtype with robust SNCA overexpression; altered TF networks/chromatin accessibility in this subtype
notes: Verified. PD tissue from Banner Sun Health; Chiba-Falek lab.

title: Comparative mapping of single-cell transcriptomic landscapes in neurodegenerative diseases
accession: NA (not found in text; likely Synapse)
main_conclusions_short: Same inhibitory neuron subtype depleted in AD and DLB; candidate disease-driver neuronal subtypes in PD and DLB; cell-cell communication up in AD, down in DLB/PD; AD-PD most divergent, DLB intermediate
notes: Verified counts. PD and control samples likely overlap shwab2024.

title: Single cell transcriptomics reveals enrichment of aggregation-prone alpha-synuclein isoforms across synucleinopathies
main_conclusions_short: Novel SNCA isoforms discovered; aggregation-prone SNCA isoforms enriched in PD and DLB; isoform expression mapped to cell subtypes
notes: Abstract only. Probably reuses shwab2024/2025 samples (inferred).

title: Single-nucleus transcriptomics reveals disease- and pathology-specific signatures in alpha-synucleinopathies
main_conclusions_short: iPD and LRRK2-PD share signature distinct from MSA; global decrease of neuronal transcriptional output; DE concentrated in deep-layer (L6) ADRA2A+ excitatory neurons; pathology-specific signatures in LRRK2-PD with vs without Lewy pathology
notes: Verified (Tzoulis lab, Bergen).

title: Single-nucleus transcriptomics reveals a distinct microglial state and increased MSR1-mediated phagocytosis as common features across dementia subtypes
main_conclusions_short: Elevated microglial proportions across AD/DLB/PDD; shared myelin-enriched microglial state; increased MSR1-mediated myelin phagocytosis across dementia subtypes
notes: DAS verified. Group n not extracted; GEO has 20 samples total (4 groups) - PDD group size inferred.

title: RNA Isoform Diversity in Human Neurodegenerative Diseases
main_conclusions_short: Long-read single-nucleus isoform profiles of neurodegeneration genes; cell-type-specific isoform diversity; disease-associated isoform differences in AD/DLB/PD
notes: Verified counts (Chun lab, SBP).

title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals molecular dysfunction associated with cortical Lewy pathology
modality: spatial (GeoMx DSP WTA, single-neuron ROI); mouse PFF
main_conclusions_short: L5 IT and L6b excitatory neurons vulnerable to Lewy pathology; inhibitory/PT neurons resilient; LAMDA signature: aggregate-bearing neurons downregulate synaptic, mitochondrial, UPS genes; conserved in PFF mouse model
notes: Verified DAS. Not single-cell sequencing strictly (neuron-enriched ROIs). Henderson lab (VAI), ASAP.

title: Modeling Lewy body disease with SNCA triplication iPSC-derived cortical organoids and identifying therapeutic drugs
main_conclusions_short: SNCA-high excitatory neurons show synaptic and mitochondrial dysfunction in organoids, consistent with autopsy LBD cortex snRNA; drug screen hits inhibit alpha-syn seeding
notes: Postmortem part is validation; 8 GEO samples (LBD vs control split NA). Zhao lab (Mayo). Diagnosis 'LBD' (PDD/DLB mix unverified).

title: Spatially resolved molecular signatures of Lewy body dementia
main_conclusions_short: Cortical layer 5 most vulnerable with elevated SNCA; APOE4 associated with impaired neuronal vulnerability and cell-cell communication; SNCA triplication and APOE4 converge on neuronal dysfunction
notes: Verified accession. LBD (DLB/PDD) - PD-proper donors unclear; spatial platform not verified.

title: Activation of transposable elements is linked to a region- and cell type-specific interferon response in Parkinson's disease
regions: substantia nigra; putamen; amygdala; prefrontal cortex
data_access: controlled (ASAP CRN Cloud request; Zenodo CC-BY description)
main_conclusions_short: TE expression cell-type and region specific; increased TE (LINE-1, ERV) expression in microglia and neurons in SN and putamen but not amygdala or PFC; TE activation correlates with interferon response; mechanistic link confirmed in vitro
notes: Verified donors. Team Jakobsson. Overlaps SN/striatum track.

title: Modeling cis-regulatory variation in human brain enhancers across a large Parkinson's Disease cohort
regions: anterior cingulate cortex; substantia nigra (+ motor cortex n=4 in dataset)
main_conclusions_short: 53,841 cis-variants modulate cell-type-specific enhancer accessibility (caQTL, meQTL, allele-specific accessibility); sequence-to-function models predict variant effects; PD GWAS loci interpreted
notes: Verified. Aerts lab (KU Leuven), ASAP. Pooled multiplexed donors (vireo demux). Primarily genetics; PD vs control comparisons not headline.

title: Single-cell eQTL mapping reveals convergent glial-neuronal risk architecture in Parkinson's disease
regions: middle temporal gyrus (PD5D); substantia nigra (+ meta-analysis of public cohorts)
accession: ASAP CRN Cloud PD5D (Zenodo 19938020 MTG snRNA; 19937284 hybrid selection)
main_conclusions_short: Fine-maps 90 PD GWAS signals across 9 cell types; 125 functional risk genes for 50 loci; 51% regulated in glia (esp. oligodendrocytes/OPCs); convergent glial-neuronal vesiculopathy network
notes: Abstract verified; PD5D cohort (Scherzer, Banner). Meta-analysis N=1,197 includes external datasets.

title: Integrating Long-Read Structural Variant Analysis with single-nucleus RNA-seq to Elucidate Gene Expression Effects in Disease
regions: two regions (PD5D: MTG and midbrain, inferred)
accession: ASAP CRN Cloud (Zenodo 20078329 long-read; PD5D snRNA)
main_conclusions_short: Catalog of 74,552 SVs from 100 PD-cohort brains; SVs associated with cell-type-specific expression (eQTL/ASE) near PD GWAS target genes
notes: Regions inferred from PD5D records. Same donors as lin2026.

title: PD5D_MTG_snRNAseq and PD5D_MTG_Visium10x_ST (ASAP datasets)
n_nuclei: NA (ASAP slide: >720k nuclei from 100 MTG samples)
main_conclusions_short: NA - primary PD5D MTG paper not found
notes: Dataset-only; 94 MTG snRNA, 96 MTG Visium (iLBD/PD/control). Used by lin2026, kim2026. Uncertain: main atlas paper unpublished/not located.

title: Single-nucleus RNAseq of the post-mortem cingulate cortex and substantia nigra from control and Parkinson's disease brains (ASAP dataset)
main_conclusions_short: NA - no associated publication found
notes: Dataset-only (New York Brain Bank; Menon/Sims/Al-Dalahmah co-authors). Same group as Ma 2025 Nat Commun SN spatial (other track). Could be the 'Menon et al.' seed - uncertain.

title: Single nucleus RNA-sequencing of human postmortem hippocampus, middle frontal gyrus, and substantia nigra (ASAP dataset)
regions: hippocampus; middle frontal gyrus; substantia nigra
accession: ASAP CRN Cloud; Zenodo 19936443 (+ bulk MFG 19936442)
main_conclusions_short: NA - no associated publication found
notes: Dataset-only; all 3 regions co-sampled per donor. Team affiliation not verified.

title: Single-nucleus multiome of PD donor brain regions (IGVF portal, preview)
regions: middle temporal gyrus; posterior cingulate; putamen; substantia nigra; cerebellar cortex (pooled)
main_conclusions_short: NA - unpublished
notes: Inferred from IGVF tissue records (Gladstone, Corces lab). Low confidence; check for preprint.

title: Single-cell Spatial Transcriptomics Reveals Disease-specific Microenvironmental Niches in Neurodegeneration and COVID-19
regions: dorsolateral prefrontal cortex; anterior cingulate cortex
n_other_disease: FTD NA; DLB NA; COVID-19 NA (40 samples total)
main_conclusions_short: Layer- and region-specific disease signatures; in PD stressed neurons form microenvironmental gradients (metabolic/protein degradation up near epicentres, regenerative programs with distance); COVID-19 immune infiltration of white matter
notes: Abstract only. Saarland group (Keller/Mirzac co-author).

title: Clonal CD8+ T cells populate the leptomeninges and coordinate with immune cells in human degenerative brain diseases
main_conclusions_short: Leptomeninges harbour clonally expanded CD8 TRM cells; maximal clonal expansion decreased in AD; brain and leptomeningeal TCR repertoires overlap with tissue-specific clones in AD
notes: Verified DAS. PD donor count not extracted; PD conclusions minor. Elyaman lab.

title: A cross-disease resource of living human microglia identifies disease-enriched subsets and tool compounds recapitulating microglial states
n_other_disease: AD, ALS, MS, epilepsy and others (74 donors total)
main_conclusions_short: Oxidative vs heterocyclic metabolism divide; antigen-presentation, motility, proliferation subsets; subsets enriched for ND risk genes/DAM; camptothecin recapitulates states
notes: UNCERTAIN whether PD donors are included - verify before inclusion. De Jager lab.

title: RNA- and ATAC-sequencing Reveals a Unique CD83+ Microglial Population Focally Depleted in Parkinson's Disease
regions: substantia nigra; ventral tegmental area; substantia innominata; hypothalamus
main_conclusions_short: CD83+/HIF1A microglial state (M8) strongly depleted in PD SN vs control and vs other PD regions; TMEM163-high pro-inflammatory clusters and proliferative microglia enriched in PD SN
notes: Verified from bioRxiv. Subcortical multi-region - overlaps SN track. Columbia (Bradshaw lab).

title: Adult human subventricular zone microglia promote a pro-neurogenic niche for neuronal progenitors in Parkinson's disease
main_conclusions_short: SVZ microglia show disease-dependent signatures in PD and AD; PD SVZ microglia promote pro-neurogenic niche for neuronal progenitors in culture
notes: Abstract only. Periventricular region, not cortex - include only if scope covers SVZ.
